name: Template report
$fence: EXAMPLE, NOT A PART. Dave, 14:55 2026-10-02, call 7, verbatim: "the page templates are only example or inspiration in the library for designers. automated build need to ignore these, I don't want builds to trace pages. However we probably need to create some standardised templates for some programs. They all need to be properly built. for now we have the prepped properly but we ignore them until we are working with programs to define them." So: this page is properly composed of parts (s313-D72) AND fenced — the compose door (_compose_slice.py load_graph) skips it, the generate-from-canon skill never starts from it, and _validate_example_fence.py refuses a build that reads or traces it.
purpose: A report page: a provenance-bearing report header, a stats band, charts, and the table that makes the charts auditable. A dashboard answers 'how are things right now'; a report is a CLAIM ABOUT A PERIOD, made at a MOMENT, from a stated SOURCE, and it has to be checkable. That difference is the template's whole contribution and it shows up in three places a dashboard has no need for: the provenance row, the table carrying the same figures the charts draw, and the footnote block.
$provenance-note: NEW at #210 (wave 6, lane B) against the Layer-2 P3 fan-out brief - itinerary row 113. PROPOSED, NOT RULED. Layer-2 rows have no ruled artefact form; this file ships in the library's grammar on the brief's PROPOSED convention (s182-D2, the Kpi-tile precedent). No registration was performed: no CATEGORIES entry, no MIGRATED_SNIPPETS entry, no component-types.json membership, no canon.css block, no _rulings.json line, no gen_kg_edges.py run, no git operation. Deleting this pair costs nothing because nothing points at it.
$layer-note: The wave-5 and wave-6 briefs PROPOSED the meta key `layer`. meta.schema.json is additionalProperties:false with patternProperties '^\\$' only, so a bare `layer` key FAILS probe P-1 (probe_meta_schema.py). `$layer` is the legal form and is what is used here - the correction #210 wave-5 lane C reported, carried forward, not re-discovered. A `$`-prefixed key is an ANNOTATION by the schema's own grammar: if Layer-2 membership is meant to be queryable structure it wants a real enum property and a schema amendment. Still open, still Dave's.

The template is a composed PAGE: its snippet links canon/canon.css and places each part above as its own .cn-<slug> scope with the part's own markup; the page's <style> carries placement rules only (s305-D57 rule 3a; s307-D75). accessibility.roles: No invented roles. <main> with an <h1>; the provenance row is a real <dl>; each chart is a <figure> with a <figcaption> and role="group"; the table is a real <table> with scope="col" headers and aria-sort.
accessibility.keyboard: Tab order follows source order: breadcrumb, page actions, period switcher, then each sortable column header, then nothing - the page is a document.
accessibility.announcements: None. A report is a document, not a stream.
accessibility.states: aria-pressed on the period switcher; aria-sort on every sortable column.
accessibility.targets: ⚠ MEASURED ON THE #210 BUILD, before the #314 rebuild as a composed page; not re-measured at #314. MEASURED at 1400px: buttons 100x44 and 116x44; every sort header 44px tall (237x44, 171x44, 188x44, 166x44, 268x44). Period segments are 40px tall - View-options' shipped geometry, inherited and reported, not quietly enlarged.
accessibility.$colourIsNeverAlone: Every settlement chip carries its word; its dot is aria-hidden. Every chart's meaning is available in the table below it and in each figure's accessible name.
accessibility.$chartAccessibleNames: Each bar and each line marker carries a role="img" with a value in its accessible name, and each chart's <svg> carries a full sentence naming every category and value.

antiPatterns: Putting two fixed-canvas charts side by side. MEASURED: two panels need 2 x (580 + 48) + 32 = 1288px of container and this page's frame caps at 1120px, so the two-column draft made BOTH charts scroll horizontally at full desktop width with every gate green. One chart per row, stated as arithmetic.

Making a chart fluid by setting width:100% on its SVG. That stretches the viewBox and scales the text and strokes with the pane - the banned physics _RUNBOOK-render-verify.md records Dave catching in his own browser. A chart's answer to a narrow container is its own .dv-stage{overflow-x:auto}.

Byte-lifting a chart specimen and keeping its DEMO DATA. Lifted verbatim, this page drew 'Groceries, Transport, Housing' directly above a table of settlement routes. Geometry is the source's; category labels are DOMAIN CONTENT and were never the chart component's to own.

Substituting longer category labels than the source's. The specimen's label positions were generated for the source's strings and do not move: full trading names produced five overlapping label pairs, the worst by 13.0px. Comparable lengths, and RE-MEASURE.

Carrying a chart specimen without every var its markup reads. Chart-line's specimen holds two HIDDEN baked views (a ghost series and a target line) which consume data-target chrome AND depend on .dv-off being carried; without .dv-off both paint over the chart, and a dangling var() in an SVG paint property falls back to BLACK, in silence.
Publishing a report without its provenance. Period covered, prepared-at, source and currency are not decoration; without them the numbers cannot be checked.

Copying a part's rules onto the page. The page places parts (its own .cn-<slug> scope + the part's own markup) and never resizes or restyles them (s305-D57 rule 3a, s307-D75). A template that re-declares a Button ladder, a Summary row or a Data-grid toolbar forks the part the moment the part moves.
